# Contributing Guide

## Branching Strategy

We use the following branch flow:

feature/* → develop → main

- No direct commits to `main`
- No direct commits to `develop`
- All changes must go through Pull Requests

## Pull Request Rules

- At least 1 approval is required
- The last push must be approved by someone other than the author
- All conversations must be resolved before merging
- Direct pushes to protected branches (main and develop) are not allowed

## Rules

- Never use force push on shared branches
- Never merge feature branches directly into main
